author: Pallas, 1811
summary: 산지의 벼랑과 비탈, 하천 부지에 사는 새로, 한국 북부 등지에서 겨울을 난다. 겨울에는 10마리에서 수백 마리에 이르는 큰 무리로 지낸다. 화본과·여뀌과·질경이과·콩과 식물의 씨앗 등을 먹는다. 시베리아 동부 산악 지대, 쿠릴 열도 북부, 홋카이도 등지에서 번식하고, 사할린, 쿠릴 열도, 일본 북부와 중부, 우수리 등지에서도 겨울을 난다.

sexes.female: 수컷보다 색이 연하고, 배와 허리가 연한 푸른빛이 도는 은회색이다.

art.subject: Asian Rosy Finch (Leucosticte arctoa), adult male in winter, as seen on Korean mountain slopes from December to March: forehead, lores and the area around the bill sooty blackish; crown and nape covered by golden-buff to cinnamon-brown feather tips, giving the rear of the head a warm tawny look that contrasts with the dark face; throat and breast dark sooty grey-brown; mantle and back dark brown with buff feather edges; belly, flanks and rump blackish-brown, boldly scaled with rose-pink feather tips; wing coverts and edges of the flight feathers broadly rose-pink; tail blackish-brown, notched; bill yellow with a dark tip; dark eye; black legs.
art.pose: foraging for seeds on the ground in a flock, one bird in side view
art.scene: Korean winter mountains: rocky cliffs and slopes above a stony riverbed with dry grass; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male winter, side view on the ground: sooty blackish face around the bill, golden-buff to cinnamon crown and nape, dark sooty grey-brown breast, dark brown back with buff edges, rose-pink scaling on the belly, flanks and rump, broad pink edges on the wing coverts, blackish-brown notched tail, yellow bill with a dark tip, black legs

adult female winter, side view on the ground: duller grey-brown overall with a less contrasting buff nape, and much less and fainter pink on the belly, rump and wings; yellow bill with a dark tip, black legs
art.build: Stocky finch, slightly larger than a sparrow, with a rounded head, short thick neck and long wings that reach well down the tail at rest. Bill short, conical and pointed, shorter than the head. Legs short, black. Tail medium length, clearly notched. Feeds on the ground in tight flocks, walking and shuffling among stones; whole flocks rise and wheel together.
avoid: Do not paint a red head or breast like a rosefinch; the pink appears only as feather tips on the belly, flanks, rump and wings.
Do not paint a dark or reddish bill on winter birds; in winter the bill is yellow with a dark tip.
Do not make the body pale grey; it is dark sooty grey-brown, with a tawny golden-buff crown and nape.
Do not paint the whole head plain grey or black; only the face around the bill is blackish.
Do not paint pink legs; they are black.
